description: One brief → a whole campaign in ONE look on ONE design: an Instagram post, a story and a wide banner by default; `flyer: true` adds an A4 flyer, or pass the formats / sizes the person names. One palette, type pairing and brand; each format laid out for its own shape, never stretched, and checked like a single design. Use it for «a campaign», «post + story + banner for my launch». Counts as one design. Then animate_design on the story, export_campaign for every file. Example: { brief: «autumn menu at my café, warm minimal», headline: «Autumn is here», cta: «Come by», brand: «Kava», flyer: true }. Optional `references` (visual references: a brand’s page, a pin, a shot) make it follow their style and layout with the person’s own words and photos.

brief.description: what the campaign is for, in the person’s words

eyebrow.description: the small line near the headline (a date, a tag)

flyer.description: true: also a one-page A4 flyer

formats.description: which formats (default post, story, banner; also square, thumbnail — a YouTube thumbnail — and flyer or a4)

headline.description: the big line, 2–6 words (\n for a line break)

name.description: the file’s name; e.g. «Autumn menu campaign»

photo.description: IN ENGLISH, words for the photo used across the set; none: picked by the brief

references.description: Optional visual references, 1–3 public https addresses, best first: the brand’s own page (its type, palette, buttons), then a pin, Behance or Dribbble shot — best the picture’s own address (i.pinimg.com…) — whose layout and look are followed closely; words, photos and logos stay the person’s own.

sizes.description: other sizes the person names, in px («a 1200×628 Facebook ad»)

style.description: a style in words, or a pack id (tolva, dayrate, northpace, oscilla, second-draft, maplebrook, ambra)

name: create_campaign
title: Create a campaign
